profile.name: 通用SCPI函数发生器
profile.description: 用于与通用 SCPI 兼容函数发生器通信的仪器，可配置输出波形类型、频率、直流偏置和相位，在实验中用于产生电信号激励与测试波形。
profile.description_en: An instrument for communicating with generic SCPI-compliant function generators. It can configure waveform type, frequency, DC offset, and phase for generating electrical stimulus and test waveforms in laboratory experiments.

registry.description: Physik Instrumente Scpi Function Generator 仪器是由Physik Instrumente (PI)生产的表征设备。支持Signal, Slot, phase等操作。
